MFF_ACTIVE_LOAN.query: select l.loan_account_no||' - '||a.application_no d,l.loan_id r from mff_loans l join mff_applications a on a.application_id=l.application_id where l.loan_status in ('ACTIVE','DELINQUENT') order by l.loan_account_no

MFF_ALLOWED_TRANSITION.query: select nvl(s.name_en,s.name_ar) d,t.to_status_code r from ref_mff_status_transition t join ref_mff_application_status s on s.code=t.to_status_code where t.from_status_code=:P29_CURRENT_STATUS and t.active_flag='Y' and (t.role_code is null or t.role_code=:P29_ROLE_CODE) order by s.display_order

MFF_APPLICATION.query: select a.application_no||' - '||nvl(p.full_name_ar,'?') d,a.application_id r from mff_applications a join mff_persons p on p.person_id=a.primary_person_id order by a.application_id desc

MFF_APPLICATION_DOCUMENT.query: select nvl(t.name_en,t.name_ar)||' - '||nvl(d.file_name,'#'||d.document_id) d,d.document_id r from mff_application_documents d left join ref_mff_document_type t on t.code=d.document_type_code where d.application_id=:P54_APPLICATION_ID order by d.document_id desc

MFF_CASE_STATUS.query: select 'Open' d,'OPEN' r,1 seq from dual union all select 'In Progress','IN_PROGRESS',2 from dual union all select 'Closed','CLOSED',3 from dual union all select 'Cured','CURED',4 from dual order by seq

MFF_CHECK_RESULT.query: select 'Pass' d,'PASS' r,1 seq from dual union all select 'Warning' d,'WARN' r,2 seq from dual union all select 'Fail' d,'FAIL' r,3 seq from dual union all select 'Override' d,'OVERRIDE' r,4 seq from dual order by seq

MFF_CITY.query: select nvl(name_en,name_ar)||' ('||code||')' d, code r from ref_mff_city where active_flag='Y' order by governorate_code,display_order,name_ar

MFF_CONTRACT_STATUS.query: select 'Draft' d,'DRAFT' r,1 seq from dual union all select 'Signed','SIGNED',2 from dual union all select 'Cancelled','CANCELLED',3 from dual order by seq

MFF_CREDIT_BUREAU.query: select nvl(org_name_en,org_name_ar) d, org_id r from mff_organizations where org_type_code='CREDIT_BUREAU' and active_flag='Y' order by 1

MFF_CREDIT_INQUIRY_RESULT.query: select 'Accepted' d,'PASS' r,1 seq from dual union all select 'Rejected','FAIL',2 from dual union all select 'Refer / Review','REFER',3 from dual order by seq

MFF_DECISION_CODE.query: select nvl(name_en,name_ar) d, code r from ref_mff_decision_code where active_flag='Y' order by display_order

MFF_DELINQUENCY_STAGE.query: select nvl(name_en,name_ar) d,code r from ref_mff_delinquency_stage where active_flag='Y' order by display_order

MFF_DOCUMENT_TYPE.query: select nvl(name_en,name_ar) d, code r from ref_mff_document_type where active_flag='Y' order by display_order

MFF_EMPLOYMENT_TYPE.query: select nvl(name_en,name_ar) d, code r from ref_mff_employment_type where active_flag='Y' order by display_order

MFF_EVENT_TYPE.query: select nvl(name_en,name_ar) d,code r from ref_mff_event_type where active_flag='Y' order by display_order

MFF_FINANCIERS.query: select nvl(org_name_en,org_name_ar) d, org_id r from mff_organizations where org_type_code in ('BANK','NBFI') and active_flag='Y' order by 1

MFF_FUND_ORGS.query: select nvl(org_name_en,org_name_ar) d, org_id r from mff_organizations where org_type_code='FUND' and active_flag='Y' order by 1

MFF_GENDER.query: select 'Male' d,'M' r,1 seq from dual union all select 'Female','F',2 from dual order by seq

MFF_GOVERNORATE.query: select nvl(name_en,name_ar) d, code r from ref_mff_governorate where active_flag='Y' order by display_order,name_ar

MFF_INCOME_TYPE.query: select nvl(name_en,name_ar) d, code r from ref_mff_income_type where active_flag='Y' order by display_order

MFF_LEGAL_ACTION_TYPE.query: select 'Legal Notice' d,'NOTICE' r,1 seq from dual union all select 'Demand Letter' d,'DEMAND' r,2 seq from dual union all select 'Court Case' d,'COURT_CASE' r,3 seq from dual union all select 'Execution' d,'EXECUTION' r,4 seq from dual union all select 'Property Sale' d,'PROPERTY_SALE' r,5 seq from dual union all select 'Other' d,'OTHER' r,6 seq from dual order by seq

MFF_MARITAL_STATUS.query: select nvl(name_en,name_ar) d, code r from ref_mff_marital_status where active_flag='Y' order by display_order

MFF_OFFER_STATUS.query: select 'Draft' d,'DRAFT' r,1 seq from dual union all select 'Issued','ISSUED',2 from dual union all select 'Accepted','ACCEPTED',3 from dual union all select 'Declined','DECLINED',4 from dual order by seq

MFF_OPEN_ASSIGNMENT.query: select assignment_type||' - '||assigned_to||' (#'||assignment_id||')' d,assignment_id r from mff_work_assignments where application_id=:P29_APPLICATION_ID and nvl(assignment_status,'OPEN')<>'COMPLETED' order by assignment_id desc

MFF_PROGRAM_VERSIONS.query: select program_code||' - '||version_no||' - '||program_name_ar d, program_version_id r from mff_program_versions order by program_version_id

MFF_PROJECTS.query: select project_code||' - '||project_name_ar d, project_id r from mff_housing_projects where active_flag='Y' order by project_name_ar

MFF_PROPERTY_REG_STATUS.query: select nvl(name_en,name_ar) d, code r from ref_mff_property_reg_status where active_flag='Y' order by display_order

MFF_SETTLEMENT_TYPE.query: select 'Full Settlement' d,'FULL' r,1 seq from dual union all select 'Partial Settlement','PARTIAL',2 from dual order by seq

MFF_SUBSIDY_STATUS.query: select 'Pending' d,'PENDING' r,1 seq from dual union all select 'Approved','APPROVED',2 from dual union all select 'Rejected','REJECTED',3 from dual order by seq

MFF_SUPPORT_TYPE.query: select nvl(name_en,name_ar) d, code r from ref_mff_support_type where active_flag='Y' order by display_order

MFF_USER_ROLE.query: select nvl(name_en,name_ar) d,code r from ref_mff_user_role where active_flag='Y' order by display_order

MFF_VERIFICATION_STATUS.query: select 'Pending' d,'PENDING' r,1 seq from dual union all select 'Verified','VERIFIED',2 from dual union all select 'Rejected','REJECTED',3 from dual order by seq

MFF_YES_NO.query: select 'Yes' d,'Y' r,1 seq from dual union all select 'No','N',2 from dual order by seq
